statement: SDL models one active MotionPlus mode and gyro decoder, not a recursive second MP. On Linux it omits the A600FE activation write, depending on hid-wiimote; it can also retain a stale cached mode. Plus plus external MP or original nested MPs thus yield at most one software-recognized MP stream, or nonrecognition, conditional on upstream identity and frame replies. Ordinary Nunchuk/Classic use their own pass-through modes.
